The animal has reddish-brown fur on its head and back, transitioning to white/cream on its chest and underbelly. Its eyes are dark and glossy, ears are small and rounded, and the snout is pointed. The body is partially obscured by the foreground vegetation, but the visible portion suggests an elongated, slender form typical of mustelids.
